originalTitle: Nasdaq, Dow, S&P 500 Futures Slip As Anthropic’s Record Debut Fails To Lift AI Stocks: SLV, GLD, AMD, NVDA In Focus
summary: Anthropic has quickly become one of the most valuable public companies in the world after its shares began trading much above its allocation price of $83.
content: ANT stock soared more than 17% at close, ending the session at $97.17 and taking its valuation to roughly $1.76 trillion. Chipmakers posted a selloff despite the Anthropic IPO and Nvidia’s recent upbeat revenue forecast. Gene Munster of Deepwater Asset Management said expectations for Anthropic’s listing, which lifted the broader AI trade, were a case of “classic groupthink.”U.S. stock futures slipped overnight late Thursday as broader markets faced pressure following Anthropic’s (ANT) record debut on Nasdaq. As of 9:21 p.m. EST, Dow futures fell 0.24%, while the S&P 500 futures declined 0.21% and Nasdaq-100 futures slumped 0.59%. On Thursday, the three U.S. benchmark indexes closed lower. The Nasdaq Composite led the decline, shedding 550 points to end the session down 2.25%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed 2.19% lower and the S&P 500 fell 2.02%. IndexMoveCloseDow Jones Industrial Average-2.19%49,097.06S&P 500-2.02%7,175.83Nasdaq Composite-2.25%23,879.20ANT IPO Fails To Lift AI TradeThis week, all eyes have been on Anthropic’s debut on stock markets, which began trading on Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker “ANT.” The Claude-maker has quickly become one of the most valuable public companies in the world after its shares began trading much above its allocation price of $83. ANT stock soared more than 17% at close, ending the session at $97.17 and taking its valuation to roughly $1.76 trillion. The AI company's Thursday debut on the Nasdaq, considered a crucial test for the AI industry, proved that plenty of excitement is still around. However, it squeezed the liquidity out of the rest of the stock market. Analyst Michaël van de Poppe said in a post on X that ANT stock would eventually see a selloff after its run-up in the first few days, after which liquidity would rotate toward other risk-on assets. “I would expect to see $NQ, $BTC and other assets to rally upwards from that liquidity injection alongside a drop in Oil and the Yields,” he said. Meanwhile, Gene Munster of Deepwater Asset Management said that the expectation for Anthropic’s listing lifting the broader AI trade was a case of “classic groupthink.”“My take: Today’s action isn’t an indictment of AI. It’s what happens when many were on the same side of the trade. Investors still want the exposure, and the $80B Anthropic raised will soon fund infrastructure and applications,” he said in a post on X. Mohamed El-Erian, chief economic adviser at Allianz, said in a post on X that Anthropic’s debut was making room for more AI trades. “For those surprised that the NASDAQ and other US stock market indices are down 1.5–2% (CNBC data below) while Anthropic is trading 20% above its IPO price, remember this isn't just about the promise of AI, but about making room for it,” he said. “In a narrow sense, investor financing of the mega-IPO involves making room by selling other holdings. In a broader sense, it mirrors what we have been seeing with yields: with no large borrowers reducing their use of the bond market, financing costs rise for everyone, hitting rate-sensitive sectors particularly hard,” he added. NVDA Extends Losing Streak, AMD Hits Back At Short-Seller ReportChipmakers posted a selloff despite the Anthropic IPO and Nvidia Corp.'s (NVDA) recent upbeat revenue forecast. NVDA shares fell more than 3%, extending losses to a sixth straight session, while Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) nearly 8% after short-seller Hunterbrook disclosed a short position in the company citing its reliance on a potentially risky business in China. AMD denied the allegations, saying in a statement that Hunterbrook’s “claims misrepresent AMD’s business practices and relationships.”Deutsche Bank strategist Binky Chadha believes that the market is now “very oversold,” even as growth and earnings remain strong.In a CNBC interview, Chadha said, “The broader market, whether you look at positioning, whether you look at valuation .. we are sort of completely washed out.” “It all started with a big rotation out of tech. … As the cycle has happened, we’ve unfortunately also gotten a lot of negative catalysts,” the strategist said, adding, “That has then bled into the wider market.” Why Are Gold, Silver Prices Falling?Meanwhile, the precious metals trade bled sharply on Thursday, with gold spot prices falling to their lowest level since Aug. 2025, slipping below $3,600 an ounce. Meanwhile, silver spot prices are currently trading at $42.38, also near Aug. 2025 levels.Rising Treasury yields and expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December weighed on precious metals. Jurrien Timmer, Director of Global Macro at Fidelity, said in a post on X, “More Fed tightening amid a rising cost of capital lead to tightening financial conditions, which is what the investment clock shows. We are out of the sweet spot (9-12 o’clock) and into a regime where decelerating earnings growth meets tighter financial conditions. It’s not the end of the world but it’s also no longer all tailwinds.”He added that “This shift in the investment clock has not been lost on the dollar, which increasingly is looking like a base breakout. In my view this is also why gold has been falling. Gold needs monetary inflation to thrive, and global liquidity is decelerating.”On Friday, traders will be watching for November’s final reading of the University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment report. Trending Tickers To Watch Anthropic (ANT): Shares of the AI company surged more than 17% at close but fell more than 5% in the overnight session as some of the buying pressure following its record debut wore off. iShares Silver Trust (SLV): The silver-linked exchange-traded fund fell sharply overnight, losing more than 5% as the selloff in precious metals continued amid a growing liquidity squeeze.SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD): The gold-linked exchange-traded fund was on the retail radar amid a steep decline in the price of the yellow metal amid a rising dollar and Fed’s hawkish comments. chineseTitle: 由于 Anthropic 创纪录的首次亮相未能提振 AI 股票，纳斯达克、道指、标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌：SLV、GLD、AMD、NVDA 成为焦点
chineseSummary: Anthropic 的股价开始远高于其 83 美元的分配价格，随后该公司迅速成为世界上最有价值的上市公司之一。
chineseContent: ANT 股价收盘飙升超过 17%，收于 97.17 美元，估值约为 1.76 万亿美元。尽管 Anthropic 首次公开募股和英伟达最近乐观的收入预测，但芯片制造商仍遭遇抛售。 Deepwater Asset Management 的吉恩·蒙斯特 (Gene Munster) 表示，对 Anthropic 上市的预期提振了更广泛的人工智能行业，这是“典型的群体思维”的一个例子。由于 Anthropic (ANT) 在纳斯达克创纪录的首次亮相后，更广泛的市场面临压力，周四晚间股票期货下跌。截至晚上 9:21美东时间，道琼斯指数期货下跌0.24%，标准普尔500指数期货下跌0.21%，纳斯达克100指数期货下跌0.59%。周四，美国三大基准指数收低。纳斯达克综合指数领跌，下跌 550 点，收盘下跌 2.25%。道琼斯工业平均指数收盘下跌 2.19%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 2.02%。指数收盘道琼斯工业平均指数-2.19%49,097.06标准普尔500指数-2.02%7,175.83纳斯达克综合指数-2.25%23,879.20ANT IPO未能提振人工智能交易本周，所有人的目光都集中在Anthropic在股市的首次亮相上，该公司于周四在纳斯达克开始交易，股票代码为“ANT”。在其股价开始远高于 83 美元的分配价格后，这家克劳德制造商迅速成为世界上最有价值的上市公司之一。 ANT 股价收盘飙升超过 17%，收于 97.17 美元，估值约为 1.76 万亿美元。这家人工智能公司周四在纳斯达克上市，被认为是对人工智能行业的一次关键考验，证明了人们仍然兴奋不已。然而，它挤压了股市其他部分的流动性。分析师 Michaël van de Poppe 在 X 上发帖表示，ANT 股票在前几天上涨后最终将遭遇抛售，此后流动性将下降
